name: picsart
description: Picsart AI video skills for Codex, on the Picsart gen-ai MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Make finished short videos with Picsart.
interface.longDescription: Turn a screen recording into a promo or a step-by-step tutorial, an interview or vlog into a tight vertical reel, a design into a motion ad, and a story into a short film. Built on the Picsart gen-ai MCP and one Picsart account; every paid step is quoted before anything is charged.

Cut a 30-second reel from my interview video
Make a short film about a lighthouse keeper and her cat
